Ingredients: 
- 200 grams low fat paneer, grated
- 1 onion, finely chopped
- 2 green chilli, finely chopped
- spices- red chilli powder + haldi + jeera powder + coriander powder + aamchur powder + salt
- handful of coriander, finely chopped
- regular roti dough made with whole wheat flour 
- 1 tsp ghee per paratha while cooking on tava
